summary: MNQ intraday direction prediction — ML feasibility study

experiments.finding: No OFI in training (all-zero features). AUC near-random.
With OFI in training. Still AUC < 0.5. Early stop iter=1.
LONG barely above random (0.5065), SHORT anti-predictive.
Clean directional label. Still AUC=0.49. Features have zero predictive power.

conclusion: MNQ 1-60 min direction is a near-random-walk for our feature set. No ML edge found.
missing_alpha_sources: Institutional flow (dark pool prints, block trades)
Cross-asset signals (VIX, overnight NQ, international markets)

feasible_target.mechanism: Score each ORB entry with XGBoost trained on OFI + context at entry bar
feasible_target.weekly_target_gap: $10k target unreachable with $4k DD constraint at any position size

required_for_10k_with_4k_dd.conclusion: Mathematically incompatible without L2 HFT-grade data
